name: kb_348_Normalized

schema.description: Represents a Fibre Channel volume. Fibre Channel volumes can only be mounted as read/write once. Fibre Channel volumes support ownership management and SELinux relabeling.

fsType.description: Filesystem type to mount. Must be a filesystem type supported by the host operating system. Ex. "ext4", "xfs", "ntfs". Implicitly inferred to be "ext4" if unspecified.

readOnly.description: Optional: Defaults to false (read/write). ReadOnly here will force the ReadOnly setting in VolumeMounts.

wwids.description: Optional: FC volume world wide identifiers (wwids) Either wwids or combination of targetWWNs and lun must be set, but not both simultaneously.

description:
The new Fibre Channel volume is set up for mounting with the XFS filesystem. It is attached to LUN 2 on the storage array and will be presented as a read/write device (the ReadOnly flag is false).

The connection uses the following target worldwide names: 50060e801049cfd1 and 50060e801049cfd2. No additional WWIDs have been specified for this volume.
